answers.core: Honestly can't think/know of a reason why not to include this in core.
answers.workaround: Workarounds can be created, but still would be limited, i.e: a call to a node that does not own any script, can still execute any method it inherits if given the right parameters, which would basically allow a `self.get_tree().quit()` from any peer on any node.
